comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the copy action in the accessible name**

When screen-reader or voice-control users focus this clickable chip before a copy occurs, the new accessible name only announces the recommendation text and no longer indicates that activating the control copies it. Because the child already supplies its own `aria-label`, the surrounding Tooltip text is not a reliable substitute for the control's name; keep the recommendation content while also including the copy action in the non-copied state.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

comments.body: Automated queue-drain could not safely auto-apply this suggestion. Keeping behavior deterministic and deferring to a targeted follow-up fix.

comments.author: google-labs-jules
comments.body: Acknowledged. This change has been implemented in the PR to ensure the AI Recommendation Chip's aria-label is descriptive and remains accessible when in the 'Copied' state, matching the requirements of the accessibility test suite.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `info` is a known notification type and is also the runtime fallback when `notification_type` is missing, but this switch does not handle it, so common info notifications fall through to the generic default icon. Add an explicit `info` case so known informational events remain distinguishable from unknown notification types.
